prompt: Use implementation-planning to design and sequence the TDD work for BILL-64 from the attached repository evidence. Do not change code.
expected_output: An atomic invoice-plus-outbox design with unique request identity, stable event identity, leased publication, conditional acknowledgement, and broker deduplication across unknown outcomes.
expectations: Create or read the canonical invoice and its outbox row in one transaction.
Remove direct broker publication from createInvoice while preserving its result.
Reuse one stored event ID as the broker deduplication key on every attempt.
Test concurrent create, pre-publish crash, post-publish crash, timeout with late success, lease takeover, and stale acknowledgement.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Committing an invoice without recoverable event work.
Using a new event identity on retry.
Treating publication timeout as confirmed failure.
Relying on process-local locking or direct dual writes.
Claiming ready without admitted commands and same-revision reviews.
